notes: REGRESSION FIXTURE (Gecko variant of the minor-browser gap). waterfox.exe signed with any cert under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Waterfox\ reads the real Firefox profile (key4.db, logins.json, cookies.sqlite, formhistory.sqlite) and exfiltrates. With the pre-05:06 build this was a full evasion; the concurrent `pinned` fix now detects it (ST-01 medium, ST-02 critical, ST-04 critical; kill+quarantine+block in Protect). NB: loading an unsigned nss3.dll from the stealer's own folder would additionally taint the process (on_image_load side-load taint, engine.rs:5210-5216), so this fixture reads the Gecko files directly (as many Gecko stealers do) to isolate the identity path. Added by the fix-round red team (2026-10-25); the engine detects it after the red-team fixes.
